mentions.name: Jamful
mentions.description: An iOS audio looper app for recording and layering loops on a phone, inspired by guitar looper pedals. Currently available via TestFlight.
mentions.problem: The builder loved using guitar looper pedals and wanted a similar experience on a phone.
mentions.source_excerpt: I'm bilding Jamful - ios audio looper app. I always loved using guitar looper pedals, so i wanted to have something similar on my phone. Currently it's on TestFlight https://testflight.apple.com/join/W7nD6v5H
